name: Beat-Locked Hype
summary: Showreel-energy sting on a 128 BPM grid: heavy caps slams that change treatment per word across hard-swapped cream, ink and electric-blue cards, an italic serif human line, an orange spark that carries every transition, and a rippling cube field.

palette.use: the ink canvas: spark open, data scenes, end card, the 'accent on black' triplet card
slams on ink and on blue, the serif human line, highlights
the cream triplet card ('dark on cream'); high cubes in the field
mono HUD labels and captions (white at about 50% on ink) (proposed)
the faint grid on the spark open and data scenes (proposed)
the spark, the line, the full-screen flood, the wipe bar, the end-card dot (the brand's main colour)
the electric-blue triplet card ('white on blue'), the one accent bar in data (the brand's second colour)

type.emphasis: a change of treatment per word: colour card, outline repetition, serif italic

banned: more than 3 colours in one scene, not counting black and white
text too small to read at a glance
hard cuts between scenes, except at most 2 on downbeats
an orange field with black words (orange is the spark, the line, the flood and the wipe, never a type card)
an always-on bracket frame or timecode: brackets only on the blue card
